text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is common in municipal hiring and, on its own, proves nothing — it's context, not evidence. Don't lead with it; it sounds like an accusation you can't yet support and lets them dismiss the rest.

The stronger facts are the credential gap (master's plus licence versus a bachelor's) and, especially, their silence after two weeks. That silence is what to press now: send a written follow-up citing their own policy or any applicable access-to-information route, and ask for the scoring criteria and panel notes.

If those documents show criteria that shifted toward "consultation experience" late, or unscored subjective judgments, the panel's composition becomes genuinely relevant. Build the record first.
